submitted.rationale: Photocurrent falls steadily as Ca increases: 4.13e-6 A at Ca 0.278 (idx 1), 5.9e-7 A at Ca 0.387 (idx 22) and 3.6e-7 A at Ca 0.508 (idx 10). XRD showed the same single peak near Q≈2.77 1/Å across the whole range, so no phase change explains a different optimum. Idx 1 is the most Mn-rich candidate in the library, which is at the edge where the trend points.
